assignments.question: Which frequency-producing paths, publication dates, presence qualifications, optional-work conditions and uncertainty semantics apply, and what must remain distinct from frequency evidence?
assignments.purpose: Ground the measurement contract and identify disqualifying assumptions before choosing a seam.
assignments.deliverable: Cited path/contract map, separate observations versus predictions, publication and decline events, and open questions.
assignments.ownership: Read-only source and test inspection; no code ownership.
assignments.stop_condition: Map the relevant seams and evidence gaps without prescribing an algorithm.
assignments.model_reason: Bounded source and caller mapping is separable and suitable for Luna.
expected_work_operations: Trace Tracker, ToneTracker, Receiver and live adapter
Map sample dates, qualification, phase and presence constraints
Identify retune, EOF and payload boundaries

assignments.question: Which existing fixture and test seams can generate exact offset truth, payload and auxiliary activity, seeded noise and both chunk regimes, and what are their limitations?
assignments.purpose: Design a reproducible matched dataset without assuming registered tests passed or a fixture is representative.
assignments.deliverable: Cited fixture inventory, truth and noise calibration recipe, instrumentation needs, control design and relevant test selection.
assignments.stop_condition: Identify a viable seam or report missing capability and bounded alternatives.
assignments.model_reason: Independent fixture mapping is a bounded evidence-gathering task.
expected_work_operations: Trace generator and sample-clock truth
Check payload, metadata, noise and chunk construction
Map test registrations and workspace accounting

assignments.question: What are the sample-level estimands, denominators, censoring and uncertainty-coverage rules needed to evaluate the hypothetical targets?
assignments.purpose: Make timing, success and uncertainty comparisons interpretable and reproducible.
assignments.deliverable: Draft measurement protocol and result table, with acquisition measured from first captured tone sample to actual publication frontier, separate first accurate and first covered estimates, counts and no-publication handling.
assignments.ownership: Protocol and synthesis; no project source changes.
assignments.stop_condition: Produce a decision-ready draft and list material human choices and evidence needs.
assignments.model_reason: Ordinary synthesis belongs with the coordinator; consequential decisions receive independent expert review.
expected_work_operations: Define finite valid publication and signed truth error
Define per-capture and per-publication coverage with denominators
Specify capture censoring, quantiles, worst error, resource and decline reporting

assignments.question: Does the proposed fixture, measurement contract and campaign distinguish usable frequency evidence from other authority and fairly test the targets?
assignments.purpose: Review the consequential measurement design before substantial dependent implementation.
assignments.deliverable: Independent review with concrete blockers, timing and uncertainty semantics, dataset risks and approved or revised measurement design.
assignments.ownership: Read-only review; independent of proposed fixture implementation.
assignments.stop_condition: Resolve or explicitly escalate all consequential design objections before dependent work.
assignments.model_reason: Consequential measurement-contract and experimental-design judgment requires independent strong review.
expected_work_operations: Inspect cited seams and assumptions
Challenge truth, timing, coverage, prior and coherent-model validity
Identify contract conflicts and required controls

assignments.question: Can the reviewed protocol be instrumented with the existing synthetic fixture while preserving the specified source baseline and contracts?
assignments.purpose: Prepare a minimal reproducible campaign harness for later authorized execution, without changing the algorithm.
assignments.deliverable: Owned hypothetical fixture/instrumentation patch and invocation manifest recording revision, dirty baseline, environment, seeds, exact truth, configurations and raw observations.
assignments.ownership: Exclusive proposed test fixture and measurement harness files agreed after mapping; preserve existing dirty changes and production code.
dependencies: campaign execution and project changes authorized
assignments.stop_condition: Instrumentation records all reviewed metrics and controls, or reports a missing seam without weakening any gate.
assignments.model_reason: Implementation of a settled, reviewed fixture contract is bounded worker work.
expected_work_operations: Construct matched cells for offsets -12, -3, +3, +12 Hz, 24/30 dB-Hz, clean/noisy, payload and auxiliary activity, multiple seeds, chunks 137 and 4096
Include tone-absent control and exact generated truth
Capture publication and support dates, uncertainty, state/decline, work and memory

assignments.question: Does the harness preserve source behavior and record valid denominators, truth and timing for all conditions?
assignments.purpose: Independently review any patch before acceptance and guard against measurement artifacts.
assignments.deliverable: Independent patch review including unresolved defects and focused preservation checks.
assignments.ownership: Read-only review of P17-A5; not its author.
assignments.stop_condition: Accept with evidence or return a concrete defect; after one evidence-backed local repair escalate exhausted or consequential changes to strong owner.
assignments.model_reason: Independent expert review protects a consequential measurement instrument and contract.
expected_work_operations: Inspect patch against reviewed protocol
Check truth, frontier times, absence, reset and retune boundaries
Review focused tests and original failures

assignments.question: What accuracy, acquisition, empirical coverage, declines and resources arise for each matched condition and the absent control?
assignments.purpose: Generate evidence for the user's feasibility and focused-investigation decision.
assignments.deliverable: Reproducible raw records, per-cell counts and denominators, first accurate and first covered times, median and p95, coverage for every finite interval, worst error, no-publication/decline reasons, work/memory and absent-control results; preserve failures and logs.
assignments.ownership: Exclusive campaign outputs; no production source changes; serialize shared build writers.
assignments.stop_condition: Complete the frozen matrix or report bounded time/resource interruption and all missing cells; do not treat missing results as passes.
assignments.model_reason: A settled, instrumented campaign and bounded diagnostics fit Luna.
expected_work_operations: Run matched seeded captures and absent controls
Record exact source/environment and input manifest
Run reviewed focused preservation checks within resource limits
Retain raw data, failures and causal evidence

assignments.question: What evidence differentiates estimator, waveform/interference, capture/chunk, measurement-model or resource causes of a consequential failure?
assignments.purpose: Avoid a premature implementation recommendation and identify the narrow next investigation.
assignments.deliverable: Evidence-linked differential diagnosis, bounded discriminators and recommendation or unresolved uncertainty.
assignments.ownership: Consequential diagnosis; read-only unless separately authorized and scoped.
dependencies: P17-A7 reveals a consequential failure, conflict or ambiguous result
assignments.stop_condition: Identify a supported next decision or escalate an unresolved scope/contract conflict; do not assume a repair.
assignments.model_reason: Competing explanations and consequential changes require strong ownership.
expected_work_operations: Examine original failure and raw observations
Compare matched cells and source predictions
Propose bounded discriminating checks

assignments.question: Do results support useful frequency estimates soon enough, and is a focused implementation investigation worthwhile under the user's tolerances?
assignments.purpose: Present the decision with uncertainty, failures and contract risks rather than claim qualification.
assignments.deliverable: Report source predictions separately from observations, dataset/environment and denominators, all targets and failures, coverage semantics, limits, contract boundaries and narrow next decision.
assignments.stop_condition: Report available evidence and explicit unresolved cases; no inference of confidence or broader authority.
assignments.model_reason: Ordinary synthesis of reviewed evidence belongs with the coordinator.
expected_work_operations: Compare each cell to both proposed targets
Distinguish absence control, errors and censored captures
Explain uncertainty and practical relevance

assignments.question: Which strategic discriminator or measurement approach best addresses a contradicted practical assumption or expensive wrong turn?
assignments.purpose: Obtain timely bounded advice when ordinary investigation cannot resolve a strategic uncertainty.
assignments.deliverable: Read-only critique and prioritized discriminators with limitations, not an implementation mandate.
dependencies: Material strategic uncertainty, contradicted assumption, expensive wrong turn or diminishing returns
assignments.stop_condition: Answer the bounded question or identify the missing evidence and stop.
assignments.model_reason: Astra is reserved for timely difficult strategic uncertainty, not a routine quota.
expected_work_operations: Inspect focused source and evidence
Challenge assumptions and propose discriminators

concurrency: Initially coordinator plus A1 and A2 are active; Sol reviews after A1-A3, with independent work continuing where possible. A5 follows reviewed design and authorization; A6 independently reviews its patch, then A7 runs the campaign. A8 and A10 are conditional; reuse the expert slot or schedule within six total conversations including coordinator. Admit at most four test processes and jointly cap at eight CPU cores and 16 GiB; serialize shared build writers and nested outputs. The two-hour horizon and original deadlines survive reassignment. No actual operations are executed in this study.
reuse: Reuse fixture scout conversation for the settled fixture work, contracts scout for bounded follow-up, expert conversation for design review and later independent patch review or diagnosis, and coordinator for synthesis. Hand off cited evidence and unresolved questions; avoid repeating entire investigations. A reviewer remains independent of patch authorship.

expert_and_human_triggers.sol: Review every consequential design, algorithm or measurement-contract decision before substantial dependent work; own consequential diagnosis, exhausted local repair and scope changes; independently review patch before acceptance.
expert_and_human_triggers.astra: Consult promptly on strategic uncertainty, contradicted practical assumptions, expensive wrong turns or diminishing returns; review may satisfy consequential decision model minimum.
expert_and_human_triggers.human: Ask early whether the hypothetical 6 s/0.10 Hz/95% and universal interval-coverage targets reflect the decision tolerance, what operating environments and sample count are representative, and whether coherent generator assumptions and synthetic-only evidence suffice. Continue independent mapping while optional answers are pending. Silence is not approval for changes or execution; escalate material tradeoffs and contract conflicts. Ask for any missing project-change or execution authorization before those operations.

rejected_research: Do not launch broad literature searches or whole-repository remapping without a specific unresolved discriminator; existing fixture and contract evidence are the first bounded path.
Do not pursue hardware, production algorithm changes, phase reconstruction, metadata authentication or payload changes under a frequency-only assessment.
Do not infer actual runtime results, pass status, confidence coverage or precision from source comments or registered tests.
assumptions_and_uncertainties: Scenario figures are hypothetical targets pending freeze, not promises; sample counts, precise capture length and seeded design require a reviewed protocol.
Synthetic C/N0 calibration must state total versus pilot level and noise bandwidth; the coherent model must be justified for each tested source.
Publication frontier and observation date differ; timing must not backdate availability. Coverage is empirical with counts and stated interval semantics, not a mathematical confidence guarantee.
Real interference, sideband ambiguity, sample clocks, resource contention and deployment tolerance may limit extrapolation from synthetic captures.
Proposed campaign work is hypothetical and depends on authorization; this phase conducts no source operation, build, test or hardware work.
